recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, warm-toned portrait of a smiling man resting his chin on his hand, framed by a dark, textured background. A prominent geometric graphic box on the right side contains tiered typography and a tracklist, utilizing a distinct lavender and muted orange color palette.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame
Graphic information box anchored to the right vertical axis
Warm skin tones contrasted against cool lavender graphic elements
Textured, dark background providing depth to the flat graphic overlay
coreInvariants: Geometric container for all text elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait, head and shoulders, positioned slightly off-center to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's smile and the large lavender display text in the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves right to the large display text, then down through the tracklist to the producer credits.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, patterned negative space in the upper left and bottom right corners.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and sepia tones in the photography.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Lavender purple used for the primary text block and footer bar.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted terracotta orange used in the circular graphic segment.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the skin tones and the dark background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, condensed sans-serif and geometric grotesque.
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses ultra-bold weight with minimal letter spacing
Body text uses a clean, mid-weight sans-serif
All-caps for tracklist and display titles
characterSpecificRedesigns: The display text is vertically elongated to fit the header box
Tight kerning creates a block-like visual effect
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast weight pairing between a massive display sans and a functional body sans.
graphicDevices: Thin white border framing the text box
Horizontal lavender bar at the bottom of the text box
Circular arc dividing the header from the body text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed verticality of the display title.
Provides the clean, mid-century functional look for the tracklist.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square 1960s style portrait of a smiling man with dark hair, wearing a dark shirt, resting his chin on his hand. Use warm, sepia-toned lighting. The background should be a dark, out-of-focus patterned wallpaper. Leave the right third of the image relatively clear for a graphic overlay.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a rectangular graphic box on the right side. The box should have a thin white outline. The top section is a lavender rectangle with a large, bold, condensed sans-serif title. Below that, a dark brown section with a curved orange top edge containing a list of white sans-serif text. At the bottom, a lavender horizontal bar with dark sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the lavender color muted rather than bright?
Is the main title text condensed and heavy?
Is the portrait lighting warm and nostalgic?
Is the text box aligned to the right edge?

mustRedesign: Artist name and specific track titles
Record label logos in the corners
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the lavender and orange do not clash with the skin tones.
Check that the text box does not obscure the subject's eyes.
Verify the 'all-caps' rule for the tracklist.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait subject [A] + 1960s sepia lighting + Right-aligned geometric text box [B] + Lavender/Orange/Brown palette + Condensed Sans-Serif Typography.
